Model-informed exploration of the boundaries of safe aluminium exposure from allergen immunotherapy in children. The safety of aluminium (Al) exposure from medicinal products for subcutaneous allergen immunotherapy (SCIT) is still under debate due to their administration in many doses over years. Especially for children, model-informed risk assessment is urgently needed in the absence of clinical study data.
